messages:
Vik: Postmortem linked. Need three customer-facing deliverables assigned: (1) concise statuspage blurb, (2) 72h customer brief, (3) an RCA-consent matrix + redaction checklist so CS/legal know the rules. Can we pick owners by EOD?
Hannah: I can take the statuspage blurb. Ill keep it short and non-technical. ETA 3h.
Leo: I'll draft the 72h brief and the CSM-friendly summary paragraph. ETA 24h. Will aim for plain language and an optional technical appendix for customers who request more detail.
Priya: Legal/controls here. For RCA-consent matrix: we need explicit tiers (public summary, sanitized RCA, full RCA under NDA), approval gates, and a minimum redaction checklist (PII, secrets, raw internal IPs, unfiltered auth logs). Ill draft the matrix but need infra input on what artifacts are safe to export. ETA 72h.
incident-bot: Created ACTION-5205 (comms) and ACTION-5206 (infra follow-up): https://go/reports/ACTION-5205
Vik: Proposed owners: Hannah=statuspage (ETA +3h), Leo=72h brief (ETA +24h), Priya=consent matrix + checklist (ETA +72h). Also infra asks to open pattern-review for recurring cache evictions tag: "eviction-pattern". Agree?
Hannah: Statuspage draft v1:
```
Partial degradation of request throughput affecting a subset of customers in APAC between 22:10-22:42 UTC. Services were restored following failover at 22:42 UTC. We are investigating a recurring cache eviction pattern and implementing safeguards to reduce recurrence.
```
Hannah: Adding contact line: support@redwood.ai. Also a short sentence offering direct summaries to affected customers.
Leo: 72h brief outline: tl;dr, who was affected, timeline, impact, immediate mitigation, high-level root cause, next steps (monitoring + mitigation ETA), and how customers can request the sanitized or full RCA. Will include a one-line CSM blurb for outreach.
Priya: For the consent matrix: default public = statuspage + 72h brief. Sanitized RCA = technical RCA with redactions for PII/secrets and removal of raw logs; available on request after review (legal + infra). Full RCA = provided only under NDA and after redaction review; well include a minimal allowed-attachments list. Draft will include a checkbox redaction template.
Vik: Good. On recurring pattern: infra reports 6 similar eviction spikes in the last 9 weeks. Recommend ACTION-5206 owner infra-ops and a separate follow-up to define detection thresholds and mitigation timeline. Suggested mitigation ETA: detection tuning 2w, mitigation rollout 6w.
Hannah: Quick question: do we mention "cache eviction" on the public statuspage or keep causal language more generic?
Priya: Public channels should stay high-level: "internal cache issue" or "internal resource eviction". Provide a sanitized RCA with more detail for customers who request it. Full technical artifacts only with NDA and explicit approval.
Leo: I'll include the contact & request flow in the 72h brief: support@redwood.ai and a short intake form link (internal): https://go/rca-request. Proposed SLA: 7 business days for sanitized RCA reviews; expedited reviews case-by-case.
incident-bot: ACTION-5205 updated -> owners assigned: Hannah, Leo, Priya. ACTION-5206 created -> owner: infra-ops (unassigned).
Vik: Scheduling a 20-min sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review drafts and finalize ACTION-5205. Please upload drafts to ACTION-5205 before the sync.
Hannah: Posting statuspage draft to ACTION-5205 now.
Leo: 72h draft ETA confirmed: tomorrow 08:45 UTC. I'll attach the CSM blurb and the optional technical appendix separately.
Priya: Consent matrix skeleton and redaction checklist will be in ACTION-5205 within 72h. If infra can list exportable artifacts earlier, that helps.
Vik: Final EOD checklist: update ACTION-5205 with owners + ETAs (done), statuspage posted (Hannah), 72h draft uploaded (Leo), consent matrix WIP (Priya), infra follow-up ACTION-5206 for recurring pattern. If anyone misses EOD, DM me.
Leo: ack.
Hannah: ack.
Priya: ack.
incident-bot: ACTION-5205 status -> owners set; due dates recorded.
Vik: Thanks team  great coordination. We'll close loop after the review sync.
